programs.description: Alo, an educated woman, shifts to her husband's hometown after marriage, bringing positive changes by educating and enlightening the poverty-stricken villagers.
A young man returns to his house after completion of his study abroad and meets his childhood best friend. Later, he comes to know that she is a shape-shifting snake who tries to woo him.
A scientist who wants to revive the age of prehistoric creatures conducts experiments to expand the brain of crocodiles. However, his test subject is targeted by a man who wants to profit off it.
Dev, a high-school dropout, relocates to the city in order to finish his studies. Soon, he falls in love with a girl in his college, but things go awry when she is kidnapped by a group of hoodlums.
Three men steal jewellery from a temple and put the blame on a snake charmer. Vasanthi, the snake charmer's wife, vows to seek revenge against those who killed her husband.
Leela befriends Krishna after using missed calls to scam him into recharging her phone and the two become close. However, he becomes the prime suspect when she goes missing.
A young couple must overcome internal conflicts and a series of problems that arise due to a criminal accusation in order to be united in love.
Meher Ali, a Muslim boy who lives with his widowed mother, falls in love with a Hindu girl. However, his life turns upside down when he gets convicted as a terrorist and imprisoned for life.
Due to their busy lifestyle in Kolkata, a couple who files for divorce, realises the true intensity of their bond while attending a wedding in their family.
Captain Dibyendu Rakshit finds himself in trouble when a bout of turbulence damages the plane's engines. He must find a way to land safely before it is too late.
Crime reporters Chandana and Sayantan work together to find exclusive breaking news for their television channel. However, they soon find themselves navigating a series of dangerous situations.

Suri and Raghava, two powerful mafia leaders in Andhra Pradesh, use their power and influence to take care of the people. However, when the ruthless don Feroz arrives, their reign is threatened.
Sub-inspector Dibakar Singho settles every dispute in his town with wisdom and logic. However, he is compelled to use force when an extortionist with mafia links - Arjun Sarkar - confronts him.
When Kamala's marriage is called off due to lack of dowry, Ananda saves her reputation by marrying her. Later, he abandons her on realising that she is unable to read and write.
An anthology of three stories of individuals who react differently to crime and face unexpected consequences as a result of their actions.
Aditya, a commitment-phobic hotelier, loves Esha, his innocent employee. Things get complicated when Esha's past comes to the fore, and he realises that Prachi, his associate, loves him.
An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.
A couple living in Milan, Italy, have a child together. However, their child has some special powers and a scientist on the run from the police is in search of the infant.
Sohini, a Bengali woman, gets married to Ashwin, a man from another community. When they feel lost in their lives, they decide to understand each other's perspectives.
A detective is assigned the responsibility of investigating a gang of poachers suspected of illegally hunting wild elephants in the forest.
Raka, the daughter of an influential politician, always gets what she desires. However, all hell breaks loose when she is rejected by Akash, a fellow college student.

A group of friends on vacation in Darjeeling agree to help a scientist protect his valuable formula from a Japanese spy. However, they soon suspect that all may not be as it seems.
After Rajiv and Subhra marry, their new life faces turmoil. Subhra's former lover, Raja, returns with the intention of wrecking their lives, creating unexpected challenges for the couple.
Sub-inspector Dibakar Singho settles every dispute in his town with wisdom and logic. However, he is compelled to use force when an extortionist with mafia links - Arjun Sarkar - confronts him.
When a police commissioner is accused of treachery, his son sets out to fight corruption and restore his father's dignity and pride.
Shibaji, a famous Indian boxer, loses fame overnight when he meets with a tragic accident. After losing his title, he fights all odds to revive his career and become a champion again.
Gitin is unable to go on a honeymoon with his wife, Jayanti, due to his workaholic employer. The couple seize their chance when Gitin's boss leaves for a trip, only to run into him in Mumbai.
Teenagers enjoy their school life to the fullest, until a boy gets murdered in a classroom, and everyone in the institution comes under the radar of suspicion.
A moviemaker sets out to make a biographical movie on Mayakumari, the legendary actress, and tries to find out the reasons that caused her disappearance.

The President of India returns to his hometown, Khoyragarh. However, a devastating explosion uncovers a sinister plot to assassinate him, prompting two officials to race against time to prevent the tragedy.
Kumar finds a puzzle etched onto a human skull in his late grandfather's belongings. He consults Bimal, his friend, to solve it, and together they set out on a treasure hunt in a jungle.
